prTitle: Enhance embed URL handling and validation system
head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Benchmark head 4f8aed2 is itself on upstream main: direct commit by Robin Ward, 2013-12-31 ('FEATURE: Embeddable Discourse comments, now with simple-rss instead of feedzirra'), no PR associated (gh commits/<sha>/pulls empty). Base 62db063 is the revert of the earlier attempt; diff identical to the benchmark.

tps.bug: `import_remote` fetches the embed URL with open-uri, which follows redirects, so the embeddable-host check on the initial URL can be bypassed to reach internal services (SSRF).
tps.evidenciaOpus: topic_embed.rb:48 fetches with `open(url).read` (open-uri, follows redirects), while the only host validation is TopicRetriever#invalid_host? (lib/topic_retriever.rb:14-15) on the initial URL; a redirect from the embeddable host to an internal address is fetched and its content imported into a post.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The newly added lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 validates only the original URL’s host, then passes that URL to import_remote at line 52. app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 calls open(url).read without restricting or validating redirects, allowing an allowed-host endpoint that redirects to an internal address to trigger SSRF.
